Subject: Re: Internal: Hightower RFP — regression plan draft

Markus / Naomi — attaching a short regression plan summary. Key points:
- Onboarding: full regression sweep across 1,000 sampled prompts derived from Hightower's use-cases (stratified by intent and entity sensitivity).
- Post-deploy cadence: weekly light-touch smoke tests; monthly targeted tests on high-risk intents; quarterly full regression sampling (2% drift threshold triggers expanded sampling).
- Metrics: false positive/negative rates (by label), hallucination incidents per 10k responses, response quality scoring (human eval subset), token-level latency P50/P95/P99.
- Rollback policy: automatic fallback to smaller model variant + notify ops for 30-minute mitigation window; manual rollback if quality regression persists >2 hours.

[sent with attachment: Regression-Plan-Summary.docx]

I'll put methodology notes into the Drive and prepare a one-page executive summary for procurement.
—Priyom
